snippet.title: How Oprah Winfrey  Betrayed Michael Jackson
snippet.description:
OPRAH WINFEREY BETRAYED MICHAEL JACKSON.
In 1993, Michael Jackson sat down with Oprah Winfrey in what became one of the most iconic interviews in television history. The world watched as MJ opened up about his childhood, fame, and struggles  trusting Oprah with his truth.

But years later, that trust would be shattered. Oprah interviewed Michael Jackson’s accusers during the release of Leaving Neverland, leaving many fans stunned by what felt like a deep betrayal.

This video explores the powerful friendship between Michael Jackson and Oprah, the emotional highs of their early connection, and the painful turning point that left the King of Pop betrayed.

From rare interview clips to dramatic shifts in loyalty, this is the full story of how Oprah went from ally to adversary.

 What do YOU think? Was Oprah ever truly MJ's friend? Drop your thoughts in the comments.
